gateway: isolated temporary home, approval=reads; a freshly seeded gateway for the stub screenshots, one for the live ones and one for the walkthrough
data: fictional, seeded through the app's HTTP API (capture/scenes.json)

agent_backend.live_model: the operator's own installed, signed-in kiro-cli over ACP with model "auto"; the replies on screen are that model's and vary from run to run
agent_backend.stub: Kiro Crew's offline stub ACP backend (capture/stub_backend.py) for every other scene; no chat reply is shown from it
agent_backend.credit_reading: the browser answers the top bar's credit readout (/api/sessions/usage) with "no reading", so no account balance or email can be shown

note: The isolated gateway ran Kiro Crew at the App Kit level-1 seams commit from a throwaway checkout in which the built-in PPTX Maker no longer registers (pptx_maker taken out of BUILTIN_NAMES, its app.json and its core pptx-maker skill removed) but its Python package stays importable, because today the gateway renders this app's agent templates from that package (PORTING.md gap 1). This repository was installed from a clean clone of the commit named in app_commit, trusted and enabled through the dashboard API, and its engine and icon packs were installed through the app's own routes. LibreOffice 26.8.2 (the official Linux build, unpacked, not installed) was on PATH so the engine could draw the slide previews; the managed pdftoppm was installed after the agents were registered, so the agent's own preview check could not use it (it says so in its reply). The live chat was switched to the per-chat Trust approval mode through the chat's own approval-mode menu; the gateway's default stayed 'reads'.
data_notes: Every person, place, number and address in the demo deck is made up; the e-mail address uses the reserved .example domain.

The deck was written by the live agent in the use-case-vibe scene, from the pasted notes in capture/scenes.json, into a demo deck folder (/tmp/pptx-maker-demo/decks, set through the app's Settings route); the later screenshots and the walkthrough show that same deck. Its folder name carries the capture date.
The eight styles and two templates are the ones the pinned engine ships.
